query: SELECT pc.mes, pc.ano, cs.grupoNome, SUM(CAST(cs.totalGeral AS DECIMAL(14,2))) as total FROM custo_setor cs JOIN periodo_custo pc ON cs.periodoCustoId = pc.id WHERE (pc.mes = 4 AND pc.ano = 2026) OR (pc.mes = 3 AND pc.ano = 2026) OR (pc.mes = 2 AND pc.ano = 2026) GROUP BY pc.mes, pc.ano, cs.grupoNome ORDER BY pc.ano, pc.mes, total DESC;
